description: This PHP source file defines a class for a SAPDB database driver as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for retrieving server info, primary keys, indexes, column metadata, and internal ID sequences, along with a recordset subclass specific to SAPDB.

classes.name: ADODB_SAPDB
classes.description: Database driver class for SAPDB, extends ADODB_odbc with specific implementations for SAPDB.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_sapdb
classes.description: Recordset class tailored for SAPDB, extending ADORecordSet_odbc.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Fetches server information, including version, parsing it from the description if not available.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a table, including whether indexes are unique and their columns.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a table, including data type, length, default values, and key info.

methods.name: MetaColumnNames
methods.description: Retrieves just the column names for a specified table.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Fetches the current sequence value for inserting new record IDs.
